rules.scope: All function literals in handwritten R/*.R, including S4 methods and nested/anonymous functions; RcppExports.R excluded. Package source is parsed, never evaluated.
rules.primary_complexity: cyclocomp on function body wrapped in function() with nested function literals replaced by a symbol. Formal default expressions excluded. Each function literal is a separate exclusive unit.
rules.inclusive_complexity: Additional cyclocomp on full function body including nested bodies, for top-level-owner inspection only. Never sum inclusive and child scores.
rules.cyclocomp_rule: Unmodified cyclocomp 1.1.2 control-flow graph E-N+2; if/for/while/repeat/short-circuit && and || plus its return/break/next handling. switch is not specially modeled by this analyzer.
rules.nesting: Custom static AST maximum simultaneous depth of if/for/while/repeat/switch, excluding nested functions and defaults. Braces and boolean operators add zero; else-if is another nested if. A syntactic engineering diagnostic, not cognitive complexity.
rules.LOC: Physical function spans include comments and nested functions and overlap; do not sum spans. File noncomment_token_lines counts unique lines touched by noncomment parser tokens.
rules.limitations: Quoted/unexecuted syntactic function literals and controls are counted. Runtime dispatch, dynamic evaluation, semantic duplication, direct-call coupling, cognitive complexity and human comprehension are unmeasured.
